item.title: Category Theory Illustrated – Orders
item.description:
📝 Linear order Let’s start with an example — the most straightforward type of order that you think of is linear order i. those are the rules that define which element can point to which. Orders, that don’t follow the totality law are called partial orders, (and linear orders are also called total orders.
🔗 Read more: https://abuseofnotation.github.io/category-theory-illustrated/04_order/

item.title: Amiga Graphics
item.description:
📝 Launched in 1985 the Commodore Amiga boasted graphics capabilities that were unsurpassed for it's time. It featured an intricate collection of custom chips that enabled it to do things that, until then, had been impossible to achieve with other personal computers. This site is dedicated to graphics made with or for the Commodore Amiga home computer.
🔗 Read more: https://amiga.lychesis.net/
